notes.title: The Elder Scrolls II: Daggerfall - Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
A small update has been made to The Elder Scrolls II: Daggerfall. Please find the list of patch notes below.

Added the following reference materials: [list]
[*] Game Manual
[*] Reference Card [/list]
Adjusted scaler to smooth out graphics
Updated game to Official Patch 1.07.213 [list]
[*] Various bug fixes
[*] Better support for Daggerfall Unity mod - [i]Does not include CompUSA expansion patch[/i] [/list]
